_comment: Per-op timing ceilings in seconds. Threshold checks apply a 25% tolerance band on top of these values. A case with a _provenance entry is a hosted-runner ceiling; the rest were set by hand on Apple M-series CPU and sit 2x or more above the slowest hosted run (LCD-947 audit). Record a ceiling from many runs, never one: tools/record_perf_ceilings.py; --audit sweeps the whole file against the perf-history artifacts. Re-record after intentional kernel changes.
